title: Finance Assistant Data Processor
description:
Finance Assistant/Data Processor
Tavistock, Devon
Circa £30,000 - £33,000 per annum

Our client, a well-established organisation, is seeking an experienced Finance Assistant/Data Processor to join their small and collaborative team on a full-time, permanent basis.

This Finance Assistant/Data Processor role offers a broad range of responsibilities across finance administration, data processing and reconciliations. It would suit a detail-oriented finance professional who is confident using technology, comfortable working across multiple systems, and looking to develop their skills within a supportive and collaborative team.

The role provides genuine responsibility and variety, with the opportunity to contribute to the smooth and accurate delivery of the wider finance function within a supportive team environment.

The responsibilities:
- Support day-to-day finance administration and data processing
- Prepare invoices and assist with credit control activities
- Complete regular bank and transaction reconciliations
- Support supplier payments and charity disbursement processes
- Maintain accurate donor and financial data across internal systems
- Liaise with employers, charities and financial institutions as required
- Manage shared mailboxes and respond to queries promptly
- Provide wider support to the finance and processing teams as required

The candidate:
- AAT Level 3 qualified or above, with relevant finance experience
- Strong Excel and IT skills, with confidence learning new systems
- Previous experience using Sage or similar accounting software
- Good understanding of financial controls, reconciliations and accounting processes
- Highly organised, accurate and able to work effectively both independently and collaboratively

If you would like to know more about this Finance Assistant/Data Processor opportunity, please get in touch with Rachel Dawson, here at Lloyd Barnes Recruitment.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

A growing and innovative technology business based in Exeter is seeking a Temporary Finance Assistant to join their expanding finance team. Operating in a fast-paced and collaborative environment, the business is continuing to invest in both its people and infrastructure, making this an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional looking for their next contract assignment.

Your new role

As a Temporary Finance Assistant, you will support the day-to-day running of the finance function, ensuring the accurate and timely processing of financial transactions. Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and supplier payments
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving invoice queries
- Raising and processing sales invoices
- Supporting credit control activities and customer account queries
- Completing bank reconciliations
- Assisting with month-end processes and reporting
- Maintaining accurate financial records within the finance system
- Providing general finance administration support
- Assisting the wider finance team with ad hoc projects and duties

This is a hybrid role based in Exeter, offering 4 days in the office and 1 day working from home.
What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or similar finance role
- Knowledge of accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
- Experience carrying out reconciliations
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Good communication skills with a proactive approach to problem-solving
- Competent Excel and general systems skills
- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities
- Available to start at short notice

What you'll get in return
- Competitive salary equivalent of £30,000 - £32,000
- Hybrid working arrangement (4 days office, 1 day home)
- 37.5-hour working week
- Immediate start available
- Opportunity to join a growing technology business
- Potential for longer-term opportunities for the right candidate
- Friendly and supportive team environment

title: HR Administrator
description:
Artis HR are supporting a business in Newton Abbot with the appointment of an Administrator to join their busy HR team on an initial 6-month FTC

HR experience is desirable, but not essential. This could suit someone looking to move into HR from a general administration, office administration, recruitment administration, customer service administration or similar background.

Location: Newton Abbot
Salary: £27,000

title: Customer Care Coordinator

Plymouth, Devon

title: Purchasing Assistant
description:
Purchasing & Finance Assistant

Location: Bratton Clovelly
Salary: Circa £27,000 per annum (DOE)
Reporting To: Purchasing Manager & Finance Manager

Are you highly organised, detail-oriented and looking to build a career in purchasing and finance? We're seeking a Purchasing & Finance Assistant to join our friendly and supportive team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their career, or with some administrative, purchasing or finance experience, who is looking to develop their skills across two key business functions. Full training and ongoing support will be provided.

The role is split approximately 60% purchasing and 40% finance, offering a varied workload and excellent career development opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Purchasing (60%)
- Raise and process purchase orders, ensuring records remain accurate and up to date.
- Liaise with suppliers regarding pricing, availability, deliveries and order status.
- Obtain supplier quotations and support purchasing decisions.
- Monitor outstanding orders and follow up on delayed deliveries.
- Maintain supplier records and procurement documentation.
- Reconcile purchase orders, delivery notes and supplier invoices.
- Support inventory monitoring and stock replenishment.
- Resolve supplier queries and escalate issues where required.
- Produce purchasing reports and management information.
- Work closely with production teams to ensure timely supply of goods.

Finance (40%)
- Support the day-to-day purchase ledger function.
- Process supplier invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
- Match invoices against purchase orders and delivery documentation.
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate discrepancies.
- Liaise with suppliers regarding invoice and account queries.
- Maintain accurate supplier account records.
- Support month-end purchase ledger activities.
- Assist with general finance administration and reporting.

About You

Essential Skills
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good numerical and analytical skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines.
- Positive, flexible and proactive approach.
- Willingness to learn and develop new skills.
- Team player with a reliable and professional attitude.
- Ability to commute to Bratton Clovelly.

Desirable Experience
- Purchasing, procurement, finance, accounts or administrative experience.
- Purchase ledger or invoice processing experience.
- Experience using ERP, MRP, procurement or accounting systems.
- Understanding of purchasing or supply chain processes.
- Intermediate Excel skills.

Qualifications
- GCSEs (or equivalent) including Maths and English at Grade C/4 or above.
- Further education or relevant qualifications in Business, Finance, Procurement or Supply Chain are advantageous but not essential.
- Relevant practical experience will also be considered.

Benefits
- Company pension scheme.
- Generous annual leave entitlement.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Training and development opportunities.
- Career progression pathways.
- Ongoing support from experienced Purchasing and Finance professionals.

This is an ideal role for someone looking to establish or develop a career within purchasing, procurement, finance or accounts. Previous experience is beneficial but not essential, as full training will be provided for the right candidate.

title: Finance Assistant

title: Business Administrator
description: Join our dedicated Adult Community Mental Health Team and make a real difference every day. We are seeking an exceptional Administrator to lead our administrative service, ensuring patients, clinicians and managers receive the high-quality support they need. This is a varied, rewarding and influential role within a friendly and supportive team. Based in Newton Abbot, the 30-hour post can be worked across either 4 or 5 days. This is an exciting opportunity to lead and develop the administrative service for our busy Adult Community Mental Health Team based at Estuary House. Our Business Administrator plays a key role in supporting patients, clinicians and managers, helping to ensure the delivery of a responsive, high-quality service alongside keen and engaged colleagues. You will lead a dedicated team of administrators in a positive and supportive environment where staff feel valued, motivated and empowered to succeed. Responsibilities include line management, recruitment, staff development and maintaining high standards of performance and service delivery. Working closely with the Clinical Team Manager, you will help drive continuous improvement by developing and refining systems and processes that enable clinicians to work efficiently and maximise the time they spend supporting patients. You will promote effective communication, collaboration and problem-solving across the team. The role includes minuting meetings, maintaining staffing and patient systems, ensuring compliance with Trust standards and fostering a culture of teamwork and engagement. We are looking for a proactive and organised leader with excellent IT skills, strong attention to detail and outstanding organisational abilities. Most importantly, you will be passionate about supporting others and making a real difference to both staff and patients. If this sounds like you, please apply. Please refer to the attached Job Description and Person specification which will provide you with further information on this role.

title: Team Administrator
description: Join Our Dynamic Team at Exeter Liaison Psychiatry! Are you ready to be part of a team that truly values, supports and invests in its staff? We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Administrator to join the Exeter Liaison Psychiatry team at Wonford House! We are on the lookout for an enthusiastic and highly motivated individual with exceptional IT, communication and organisational skills, with an eye for detail in typing patient assessment letters. In this key role you will support the clinical team by staying calm under pressure and expertly manage competing demands to keep the team running smoothly. Your contribution will be invaluable and we will support you in developing the skills you need to thrive. Why Join Us? Exciting and varied role in a supportive team Professional development opportunities Fast-paced, rewarding environment where your work truly makes a difference! Role Details: Office-based position in Exeter. There will be an expectation for the successful candidate to cover one evening shift until 9pm per week plus the occasional shift on a weekend. Flexible working pattern to be discussed during the appointment process. Interview date: 20 October 2026 . If you require sponsorship please review the "coming to work in the UK Visa Information" as this role does not typically meet meet the salary threshold for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship under Home Office regulations. As a vital part of the team, you will play an integral role in our Liaison Psychiatry Service. Liaison Psychiatry is the interface between psychiatry and medicine, assessing patients in the Royal Devon & Exeter Hospital. You will be supporting a multi-disciplinary team that includes Consultants, Junior Doctors, Psychologists, Nurses, Social Workers, Occupational Therapists, Healthcare Assistants and of course, our amazing Administrative team! Together, we work in a fast-paced, rewarding environment, putting patient care at the heart of everything we do! We believe in providing growth opportunities to our team members and we are committed to helping you develop and maintain the skills to succeed in your career. You will be supported by the Business Administrator to provide a comprehensive administrative support service for the multi-disciplinary team. The main duties of this role are: Team working from a shared inbox to generate letters to a high standard Entering referrals onto our patient electronic record Inputting complex and sensitive data relating to people who use our services Minute taking Data management/quality Supporting the clinical staff with admin processes Please refer to the full Job Description and Person specification attached to this advert which will provide further information on this role.
